hard_blockers.evidence: Introduction lists five contributions (design claims) but does not include explicit research questions. Contributions are framed as 'we introduce X' rather than 'we test whether X improves Y'. The pre-registered hypotheses (H1-H5) in Section 11.4 serve this role but are absent from the introduction. Partial blocker: the hypotheses exist in the paper but not where B1 requires them (the intro).
hard_blockers.note: Borderline - hypotheses exist in Section 11.4 but intro lacks explicit RQs. Scored as partial blocker; does not trigger hard cap to <=4 given the hypotheses appear later.

must_fix_actions.action: Add minimal empirical proof-of-concept: run gravity-only (B3) vs. gravity + surprise_contr + rho-routing (partial B5) on existing 185-KO corpus with 10-20 queries across 2-3 contexts. Report epistemic precision@10 and surprise recall.
must_fix_actions.acceptance_test: Paper reports at least one quantitative comparison between gravity-only and salience-augmented retrieval on real data with numerical results.

must_fix_actions.action: Add a worked numerical example showing end-to-end computation: gravity scores, modulator signals, surprise values, rho-routing, final ranking for 5-10 KOs on a concrete query.
must_fix_actions.acceptance_test: A new section or extended example with real numerical values for all intermediate computations appears in the paper.

must_fix_actions.action: Reframe contributions in the introduction as testable hypotheses with pointers to pre-registered tests in Section 11.4. Align intro framing with paper's actual epistemic status (architecture proposal, not validated system).
must_fix_actions.acceptance_test: Introduction includes at least 3 explicit, falsifiable research hypotheses.

nice_to_fix_actions.action: Conduct parameter sensitivity analysis: perturb epistemic weights by +/-50%, measure ranking stability via Kendall tau. Can be simulation-based.
Add computational complexity discussion in Limitations section (scaling properties, practical limits).
Formalize dialectic-salience mapping in Section 10 with functional forms instead of verbal descriptions.
Relabel Proposition 1 as 'Design Guarantee' or 'Invariant' to accurately reflect it follows from clamp definition.
Address H(q,i)=0 limitation in Eq. 9: discuss or mitigate that multiplicative ranking prevents surprise from surfacing semantically unrelated but epistemically critical KOs.
Address surprise saturation: what happens when many unresolved contradictions exist simultaneously? Consider normalization or top-K surprise selection.
